_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): admin dashboard home — KPI cards (totals read from the CRUD list envelope, no extra backend) + a charts grid reusing comp-charts. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-dashboard
description: Admin dashboard home: KPI cards (totals from list envelopes) + charts grid (composes comp-charts).
notes: Usage: <Dashboard cards={[{label:'Users', fetchPath:'/api/users'}, {label:'Orders', fetchPath:'/api/orders', accent:'#10b981'}]} charts={<><LineChartView data={trend} xKey='day' yKeys={['count']}/></>} />. KPI cards read {total} from the feature-crud list envelope (GET ?page=1&page_size=1) — no stats backend needed. Charts come from Charts.tsx (requires recharts: npm install recharts — see comp-charts).
